scope: Agent readability hypotheses and diagnostics; not a universal GEO ranking formula
priorities: P1: Expose model/version/market-specific facts, chart data equivalents and direct answers in readable HTML, with sources. Do not assert unresolved claims.
P1: Solve distinct find, alternatives, how-to and facts needs; deduplicate near-identical questions into useful pages rather than publishing one thin page per generated prompt.
P2: Seek genuine independent reviews and first-hand experience. Mention volume alone does not prove recommendation lift.

P3: Optionally generate Markdown and llms.txt from the same content source. Check actual responses and field consistency; missing optional files is not an SEO/GEO failure. Google Search does not use these files as a visibility boost.
measurement: Keep public HTML/robots checks, bot fetch logs, AI-referred human visits, answer citations, recommendations and factual accuracy separate.

Evaluate website changes using fixed bilingual neutral/branded panels on authorized web-enabled surfaces; preserve actual answers, final citation URLs, model/version, settings, time and retrieval mode.
No-search DeepSeek API tests are a separate brand-presence baseline, not a website-change experiment. A mention, a crawl or a parser pass cannot certify a recommendation or factual accuracy.
Resend's high recommendation share is an observational developer-tool result, not a controlled before/after trial of Markdown. Physical device shoppers and coding agents are different populations.
